paragraphs: Mentioned in Avodah Zarah 27a, reporting in the name of Rav and disagreeing with Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman says that this is not the well-known Rav Papa, but the son of Rav Papa the Elder.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The distinction concerns Daru’s father Papa; it does not identify Daru with the well-known Rav Papa. The Elder is retained from סבא.

The whole Davidson paragraph names Daru bar Papa reporting in Rav’s name beside Rabbi Yochanan’s alternative. Hyman’s concluding distinction is retained as his statement, including its “this” rather than converting it into a new identification of the father. The inherited note’s father-based interpretation remains verbatim as earlier editorial history; this comparison does not establish that interpretation or any genealogical identity.
